title: math Library
summary: Numeric helpers: clamp, floor/ceil/round, min/max, sqrt, abs, random/randomseed, huge, pi. math.clamp and math.round are Luau additions.

methods.name: math.clamp
methods.description: Luau addition. Forces x into [min, max].

methods.name: math.floor / ceil / round
methods.description: floor: down · ceil: up · round (Luau): nearest integer, half rounds away from zero.

methods.name: math.random
methods.description: No args: float in [0, 1). One arg: integer 1..n. Two args: integer m..n.

methods.name: math.randomseed
methods.description: Seeds the generator for reproducible sequences.

explanation.whatItIs: The numeric toolbox — everything from 'keep health in range' to 'roll a dice'.
explanation.whyItExists: Clamping, rounding, and randomness appear in virtually every game system.
whenToUse: `math.clamp` for any bounded value (health, progress bars, camera zoom)
whenNotToUse: Don't reseed math.random every call — you'll repeat the same 'random' number
tips: Weighted randomness: build cumulative weights and compare against math.random()
math.noise (Roblox addition) gives smooth Perlin noise for terrain/effects
commonMistakes: Expecting math.random(1, 5) to include 5 — it does! (unlike some languages)
Using math.floor for display where round is meant

examples.title: Everyday math helpers
examples.code:
local health = 130
health = math.clamp(health, 0, 100)
print(health)                        --> 100

print(math.round(3.7))               --> 4
print(math.floor(3.7), math.ceil(3.2)) --> 3  4

local loot = {"Coin", "Gem", "Sword"}
print(loot[math.random(#loot)])      --> random item

print(math.max(10, 40, 7))           --> 40
print(math.abs(-5))                  --> 5
